    19  /**
    20   * @brief Creates new vcardparameter object.
    21   * @param kind The kind of vcardparameter to create.
    22   * @return An vcardparameter with the given kind.
    23   *
    24   * @par Error handling
    25   * If there was an internal error regarding
    26   * memory allocation, it returns `NULL` and sets
    27   * ::icalerrno to ::ICAL_NEWFAILED_ERROR.
    28   *
    29   * @par Ownership
    30   * Objects created by this method are owned by the caller and
    31   * must be released with the vcardparameter_free() method.
    32   *
    33   * @par Usage
    34   * ```c
    35   * // create new parameter
    36   * vcardparameter *parameter = vcardparameter_new();
    37   *
    38   * if(parameter) {
    39   *     // use parameter ...
    40   * }
    41   *
    42   * // release parameter
    43   * vcardparameter_free(parameter);
    44   * ```
    45   */
    46  LIBICAL_VCARD_EXPORT vcardparameter *vcardparameter_new(vcardparameter_kind kind);

    48  /**
    49   * @brief Creates new vcardparameter as a clone of the given one.
    50   * @param old The existing, non-`NULL` parameter to clone.
    51   * @return An vcardparameter that is a clone of the given one.
    52   *
    53   * @par Error handling
    54   * If @a old is `NULL`, it returns `NULL` and sets ::icalerrno to ::ICAL_BADARG_ERROR.
    55   * If there was an internal error cloning the data, it returns `NULL`
    56   * without reporting any error in ::icalerrno.
    57   *
    58   * @par Ownership
    59   * Objects created by this method are owned by the caller and
    60   * must be released with the vcardparameter_free() method.
    61   *
    62   * @par Usage
    63   * ```x
    64   * // create an vcardparameter
    65   * vcardparameter *param = vcardparameter_new_from_string("ROLE=CHAIR");
    66   *
    67   * // clone the parameter
    68   * vcardparameter *clone = vcardparameter_clone(param);
    69   *
    70   * if(clone) {
    71   *     // use clone ...
    72   * }
    73   *
    74   * // release parameters
    75   * vcardparameter_free(param);
    76   * vcardparameter_free(clone);
    77   * ```
    78   * @since 4.0
    79   */
    80  LIBICAL_VCARD_EXPORT vcardparameter *vcardparameter_clone(const vcardparameter *old);

    82  /**

    92   *
    93   * @par Ownership
    94   * Objects created by this method are owned by the caller and
    95   * must be released with the vcardparameter_free() method.
    96   *
    97   * @par Usage
    98   * ```c
    99   * vcardparameter *param = vcardparameter_new_from_string("ROLE=CHAIR");
   100   *
   101   * if(param) {
   102   *     // use param ...
   103   * }
   104   *
   105   * vcardparameter_free(param);
   106   * ```
   107   */
   108  LIBICAL_VCARD_EXPORT vcardparameter *vcardparameter_new_from_string(const char *str);

   583  /**
   584   * @brief Returns the vcardparameter_kind for a given string
   585   * @param string A string describing an vcardparameter_kind

   588   * @par Error handling
